children: Smartphone maker Fairphone is opening a Series C funding round, seeking to raise at least €50 million ($58 million), like it secured in the previous round, it said on Tuesday after recording the strongest first-half results in its history.
Proceeds from the round will go toward consolidating Fairphone's share in its current markets, expanding into new ones and funding its operations, the Dutch company said in a statement to Reuters.
Phone shipments up 74% y/y in the first half of 2026, audio up 39%, accessories up 115%.
Q2 phone shipments were up 48%, audio up 33%, accessories up 146%.
Further U.S. product launches are planned; no timing given.
It is in talks with U.S. mobile network operators, which it says is central to building distribution and brand recognition there.
Fairphone is approaching 1 million devices sold and $500 million in cumulative revenue since its 2013 founding.
